records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Capsules substitute assertions and assignments for teaching. [L54](LESSONS.md#L54)/[L168](LESSONS.md#L168) are unsolved prompts; [L74–76](LESSONS.md#L74)/[L134](LESSONS.md#L134)/[L186](LESSONS.md#L186) omit essential derivations.
records.consequence: A learner may know which theorem to name without being able to derive or apply it.
records.recommendation: For each distinct missing mechanism identified in the matrix, add one concise fully specified worked derivation/trace with assumptions and boundary, then one separate evaluated core attempt. Reuse sound existing explanations; do not add whole textbook courses indiscriminately.

records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Scope mapping is mistaken for instructional completion: order statistics/UMVU/Wilks and cosine/cold-start are recognition only ([L72–76](LESSONS.md#L72),144–148); token bucket named [L218](LESSONS.md#L218); deprecation only [PLAN228](PLAN.md#L228).
records.consequence: Seven questions have no adequate mechanism-level taught-to-tested path.
records.recommendation: Add narrowly scoped core units: max CDF→expectation→bias correction; discrete max sufficient/complete→UMVU under specified sampling; LR statistic/df/regularity; cosine moments by symmetry; cold-start signals/exploration/offline gate; atomic lazy-refill pseudocode plus boundary trace; customer model-version/migration/deprecation policy with explicit constraints. Each needs an independent input and answer criteria, not another label.

records.rootCauseAndEvidence: “New” is operationalized as changed numbers/domain nouns ([CHALLENGE60](CHALLENGE.md#L60); [LESSON_TEMPLATE17](LESSON_TEMPLATE.md#L17)) rather than a changed reasoning requirement; examples listed in §6.
records.consequence: Benchmark-shaped familiarity can masquerade as transfer.
records.recommendation: Retain reconstruction for retrieval, but replace its claimed transfer role with one task that changes assumptions, representation, available evidence or failure semantics; record why the original solution no longer directly applies.

records.affectedScope: All 100; D30 and assessment access from D1
records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Final is a fixed published ten-task sample, including near-original Poisson [F2](ASSESSMENTS.md#L97) ([ASSESSMENTS.md:89–129](ASSESSMENTS.md#L89)); [index.html:1041–1063](index.html#L1041) exposes all forms. No full-100 acceptance evidence requirement is executed.
records.consequence: Final threshold can be reached with untested capabilities missing; unseen status cannot be certified.
records.recommendation: Keep existing Form B as practice/calibration. Add a held-back parallel final selected at assessment time, an explicit all-100 capability/subpart evidence audit, and independently posed variants/defenses. Preserve ≥80 and every domain floor as minimum gates, not substitutes for universal capability checks.

records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Scoring metadata says two tasks/domain but [A3](ASSESSMENTS.md#L27)–[A5](ASSESSMENTS.md#L35) are stats/modelling and only [A10](ASSESSMENTS.md#L55) is architecture ([ASSESSMENTS.md:17–55](ASSESSMENTS.md#L17)). [CHALLENGE29](CHALLENGE.md#L29) taxonomy also differs.
records.consequence: Domain scores, routing and baseline/final improvement can be wrong even with correct arithmetic.
records.recommendation: Define one canonical domain assignment/denominator and reconcile actual baseline tasks to a comparable five-domain form without lowering floors or changing recorded scores. Calibrate item difficulty before interpreting pre/post change.

records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Manifest treats each day-level optional task as a mandatory per-ID evaluator ([COVERAGE_MAP159–173](COVERAGE_MAP.md#L159) vs [DAA3](DAILY_APPLIED_ASSESSMENTS.md#L3) and [index.html:947](index.html#L947)). Generic window labels also conflict with R3 systems task.
records.consequence: False evaluator coverage; optional diagnostics may be credited despite omitted subparts.
records.recommendation: Retain optional diagnostic status; explicitly assign required core evaluator subparts and evidence contributions to each capability. Repair reverse mappings and terminology; do not infer measurement from day membership.

records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Deferred recognition is revisited by learner choice, not complete scheduling; daily ten-minute retrieval has no due-capability list ([L90](LESSONS.md#L90)/162; [CHALLENGE68](CHALLENGE.md#L68)).
records.consequence: Some skills can remain unpracticed/unretrieved through Day 30; retention UNKNOWN.
records.recommendation: Schedule a short specific retrieval/retest for each omitted capability after initial learning and after an additional delay. Reuse review time with explicit allocation and artifact links; disclose any time shortfall.

records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Self-generated cases plus generic rubrics replace calibrated feedback; [K81](ASSESSMENT_KEYS.md#L81) supplies no weekly item keys; [DAA87](DAILY_APPLIED_ASSESSMENTS.md#L87) permits surface-only recovery.
records.consequence: Misconceptions can survive correct-looking explanations and unchanged retries.
records.recommendation: Add minimal worked/checkable criteria for each compulsory exercise; require error→mechanism correction→materially changed retry with immutable before/after evidence. Obtain qualified review for claims the learner cannot self-verify.

records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Compressed explanations obscure assumptions: [K48](ASSESSMENT_KEYS.md#L48) treats retry count as necessarily relevant; [L188](LESSONS.md#L188) is ambiguous about PPO negative-advantage clipping; GAE/shaping boundaries only implied.
records.consequence: Learner can memorize misleading mechanisms and reject valid counterarguments.
records.recommendation: Correct these narrow explanations/rubrics; add a constant-kernel versus history-dependent MDP comparison, PPO two-sign branch table, and finite-terminal/critic-error boundary checks. Preserve existing outcomes and thresholds.

records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Generic systems capsule is mapped to many specific design subparts without worked mechanisms ([L216–290](LESSONS.md#L216); [COVERAGE_MAP96–129](COVERAGE_MAP.md#L96)).
records.consequence: Learner may produce component lists while missing the exact latency, safety, statistical or customer constraint.
records.recommendation: Add focused traces/checkpoints for the omitted subparts in each matrix row: audible pipeline/prosody; packing/preemption; stale-worker fencing/backoff; compensation feasibility; semantic normalization/hit rates; SQL interleaving; computable SLI denominators; fingerprint/LSH quality bounds; cost overlap; API contracts; retry-latency isolation; anti-loop budget state; graph/hidden dependencies; out-of-order checkpoint; schedule migration; virtual time; eval repetition/attribution; patch-human corpus; process rollback; GUI observation-cost; video degradation/human-rater allocation. Combine related traces rather than expanding unrelated scope.

records.rootCauseAndEvidence: No baseline or measured completion times. Normal-day cap compresses many prerequisites; optional resources limited to 15 minutes ([CHALLENGE19–45](CHALLENGE.md#L19); [SUPPLEMENTAL_RESOURCES.md:3](SUPPLEMENTAL_RESOURCES.md#L3)).
records.consequence: Completion within planned 66 hours cannot be promised; recognition routing can hide unfinished core work.
records.recommendation: Run and retain the existing baseline under a corrected scoring interpretation, pilot the densest days, record actual time per required artifact, then propose workload/routing adjustments transparently. Do not lower acceptance or silently expand stretch.

records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Source functions authorize keys for any evidence-bearing non-skipped attempt, including IN_PROGRESS; PASS checks only text/checkbox; import sanitization accepts evidence-free PASS ([index.html:779–796](index.html#L779),1044–1063,1153–1174).
records.consequence: App PASS is explicitly self-reported, not verified mastery; assessment boundary not enforced.
records.recommendation: Require an immutable finished attempt before key reveal; record assistance/exposure; retain unverified imports without treating them as verified gates; validate scores/evidence references against the actual assessment contract. A sealed new final is still needed.

records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Review Done wording alternates threshold and recovery-plan completion; app contiguous PASS gate prevents progression after a nonpass ([PLAN93](PLAN.md#L93)/195/244; [index.html:849–855](index.html#L849)). App has no learner FAIL status though final keys require it.
records.consequence: Recovery may be inaccessible or incentivize false PASS; final failure cannot be recorded with the prescribed status.
records.recommendation: Specify a recovery substep that is reachable while preserving the failed/nonpassing assessment; permit progression only once required retest succeeds. Align final result representation without overwriting old evidence or lowering floors.

records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Source omits sampling/transition/discount/event conventions or overstates feasible guarantees. Exact lines are linked in the matrix and §2.3.
records.consequence: A unique “correct answer” and competing-answer grading can be indeterminate.
records.recommendation: Add an assessment-only errata/assumption rubric accepting justified conditional answers. Do not silently change source prompts or mark defensible interpretations wrong.

records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Only unstarted baseline exists ([PROGRESS7](PROGRESS.md#L7)); no actual evidence indexes despite [COVERAGE_MAP161](COVERAGE_MAP.md#L161)/166.
records.consequence: No claim about learner performance, transfer or retention is demonstrated.
records.recommendation: During challenge execution, collect original attempts, conditions, scores, corrective retries and delayed retrieval records using the existing evidence scheme; adjudicate before accepting mastery. Do not fabricate retrospective completion.

records.affectedScope: M1–100; companion route, especially systems/product days
records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Root roadmap prescribes direct originals and a different duration, while challenge prohibits rehearsal ([Lo_trinh_hoc_100_cau_de_thi.md:283–285](../Lo_trinh_hoc_100_cau_de_thi.md#L283),428,581; [CHALLENGE63](CHALLENGE.md#L63)).
records.consequence: Following all “support” files can contaminate the benchmark and silently enlarge workload.
records.recommendation: Clearly delimit the roadmap as a separate non-authoritative route, or adapt only its useful reasoning structures into genuinely independent core tasks. Preserve source file/history; do not import benchmark rehearsals.

records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Broad phase order exists but no explicit prerequisite or support-fading map; examples/exercises/evaluators not linked by decreasing help.
records.consequence: More topic breadth can be mistaken for increasing independence.
records.recommendation: Add a compact prerequisite/dependency and support-level annotation to existing tasks; ensure later tasks remove hints and require justified selection among competing methods.

records.rootCauseAndEvidence: Simulation/failure-injection/contract-test work occurs primarily in optional DAA tasks; plans are accepted without observed tests ([DAA3](DAILY_APPLIED_ASSESSMENTS.md#L3),39,123–143).
records.consequence: The named build-test-feedback-iterate method and advanced debugging capability are not demonstrated.
records.recommendation: Require a small executable or hand-executed model for the relevant core tasks, with fixed input, predicted output, observed output, discrepancy diagnosis, revision and changed retest. A hand trace can suffice when the capability is conceptual; a test plan alone cannot.
